page_texts.1: Read `.claude/commands/standard.md` for the full workflow. Determines the architecture domain and subdomain/category (e.g. api, security, python, eks), then checks `standards/<domain>/<category>/` for an existing standard matching the request. If none exists, derives a kebab-case title slug from the request, finds the next available STD- number, copies the template from `resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/standard.md`, and creates `standards/<domain>/<category>/STD-<DOMAIN>-<CATEGORY>-<NNN>-<title-slug>.md` with status `'draft'`. If one exists, revises it in place, preserving its ID and path, bumps the version, and logs the change in its Change History. Reviews against `standards/standards-quality-checklist.md` and updates `standards/<domain>/README.md` either way. Ends with a convergence pass per `.claude/skills/ai-convergence/SKILL.md`. Standards must route through the Standards Committee per `governance/committees/README.md`.
